memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: It went to Abdon, Rehob, Hammon and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon. The boundary then turned back toward Ramah and went to the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah and came out at the Mediterranean Sea in the region of Akzib, Ummah, Aphek and Rehob. There were twenty-two towns and their villages. These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Asher, according to its clans - Josh 19:28-31 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Asher's inheritance is completed — twenty-two towns stretching up toward the great coastal cities of Tyre and Sidon. This was a generous portion, positioned along important trade routes near powerful neighbours. Yet that very position carried a hidden danger. Living so close to the wealthy, pagan cities of the coast, Asher would face constant temptation to blend in, to adopt the ways and gods of their prosperous neighbours.

Indeed, Asher's later history was mixed. This tribe never fully drove out the inhabitants of the land, and its prominence in Israel's story faded. The nearness to worldly wealth and pagan culture, which looked like an advantage, brought its own spiritual perils. Sometimes the very blessings that surround us can dull our devotion to God if we are not watchful.

This is a sober reminder for us. We too live near the "coastal cities" of a culture that prizes wealth, success, and its own gods. The temptation to blend in, to let the surrounding culture shape us more than God does, is very real. The call is to live in the world without being conformed to it, to be renewed in our thinking rather than shaped by the values around us (Rom 12:2). Asher's story warns us to stay watchful in comfortable and prosperous surroundings, keeping our hearts fixed on God rather than drifting toward the idols of our age.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What "coastal cities" of your culture tempt you to blend in?
- How can you live in the world without being conformed to its values?
- Where might comfort or prosperity be dulling your devotion to God?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, keep me watchful in comfortable surroundings. Help me to live in the world without being shaped by it, and to keep my heart fixed on You rather than the idols of my age. Amen.
